format.note: 30-round regular season, then points are halved and rounded up and the table splits: top six play a 10-match championship play-off (40 rounds in total), bottom ten a 9-match relegation play-out (39 rounds). Nothing else carries over and overall places 7-16 come from the play-out.

playoff.note: 13th and 14th each play a two-legged tie against the 3rd- and 4th-placed clubs of the Liga II promotion play-off; 15th and 16th are relegated directly. 7th and 8th play the separate European play-offs, which are out of scope.

format.note: 22 clubs play a single round-robin of 21 rounds; top six then a 10-match promotion play-off (31 in total), the other 16 split into two play-out groups of eight seeded 7/10/11/14/15/18/19/22 and 8/9/12/13/16/17/20/21 for 7 more matches (28 in total). All points are carried, unlike Liga I.

playoff.note: play-off 1st and 2nd are promoted directly if eligible; 3rd and 4th play the Liga I 13th and 14th over two legs

boundaries.note: Liga II play-off 1st and 2nd go up directly subject to eligibility; 3rd and 4th meet Liga I 13th and 14th in two-legged ties. Liga I 15th and 16th are relegated directly, 13th and 14th only if they lose. Promotion is closed to 12 of the 22 Liga II clubs in 2026-27 on legal-status/ownership grounds, so the direct places can pass down the play-off table. In 2026 only three clubs moved each way (two direct promotions plus Voluntari via the play-off).

conflicts.note: The 2026-27 Liga II article says 'twenty-two teams' twice and its league table's team list contains 22 clubs. Our 23 does not match any reading of the sources.

notes: Liga I: 16 clubs, 30-round regular season, then points halved and rounded up into a top-six championship play-off (10 matches) and a bottom-ten play-out (9 matches); 40 or 39 matches depending on the group, so rounds is the maximum. 15th and 16th relegated directly, 13th and 14th into two-legged play-offs against Liga II's play-off 3rd and 4th; 7th-8th into European play-offs (excluded). Liga II: 22 clubs, single round-robin of 21 rounds, top six into a 10-match promotion play-off with all points carried, the rest into two play-out groups of eight seeded alternately (7/10/11/14/15/18/19/22 and 8/9/12/13/16/17/20/21) for 7 more matches, all points carried. Relegation from Liga II: bottom two of each play-out group plus the loser of a play-off between the two sixth-placed clubs - five places nominally, three in 2025-26 because Politehnica Iași and Hermannstadt withdrew and two clubs were spared. Promotion eligibility is the defining constraint: 12 of 22 clubs were ineligible for promotion in 2026-27 on legal status/ownership grounds (Steaua cannot be promoted while government-owned), so a play-off winner can stay down. Liga II is closed downwards because Liga III is not modelled.
